---

### Important Reporting Rules
1. Never fabricate findings, evidence, or source references.
2. Clearly distinguish confirmed facts, assumptions, and recommendations.
3. Use consistent section numbering and headings.
4. Retain all applicable sections, even when no findings exist.
5. Use "None identified" or "Not applicable" where appropriate.
6. Highlight unresolved conflicts instead of making unsupported decisions.
7. Do not implement recommendations without explicit approval.
